problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign shipments to identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Shipment Alpha: volume 55 m³
* Shipment Beta: volume 48 m³
* Shipment Gamma: volume 40 m³
* Shipment Delta: volume 54 m³
* Shipment Epsilon: volume 31 m³
* Shipment Zeta: volume 50 m³
* Shipment Eta: volume 70 m³
* Shipment Theta: volume 56 m³
* Shipment Iota: volume 63 m³
* Shipment Kappa: volume 42 m³
* Shipment Lambda: volume 62 m³
* Shipment Mu: volume 52 m³
* Shipment Nu: volume 68 m³
* Shipment Xi: volume 45 m³
* Shipment Omicron: volume 32 m³
* Shipment Pi: volume 56 m³
* Shipment Rho: volume 61 m³
* Shipment Sigma: volume 62 m³
* Shipment Tau: volume 70 m³
* Shipment Upsilon: volume 33 m³
* Shipment Phi: volume 42 m³
* Shipment Chi: volume 51 m³
* Shipment Psi: volume 59 m³
* Shipment Omega: volume 41 m³
* Shipment Ares: volume 66 m³
* Shipment Boreas: volume 42 m³
* Shipment Ceres: volume 43 m³
* Shipment Demeter: volume 32 m³
* Shipment Eos: volume 42 m³
* Shipment Fides: volume 37 m³
* Shipment Gaia: volume 48 m³

Each cargo plane can carry up to 100 m³ of volume. Assign all shipments using the fewest planes. Each shipment must be loaded onto exactly one plane, and the total volume on a plane cannot exceed its capacity.
